correctness.rationale: At positive states the aligned Ricker exponents cancel exactly in the ratio \(x/y^{\alpha}\); the increasing leaf fixed equation gives unique \(y_K\), and its derivative crosses -1 exactly once because \(y_K\) decreases with K. The post-flip positive two-cycle for every \(K>K_c\) follows by signs of \(f_K^2(y)-y\) near zero and immediately left of \(y_K\). Three analytic derivatives at the unique critical fixed point yield \(c=(3t^2+2(5-\alpha)t+8)/(12y_c^2)\); the smooth one-dimensional flip theorem and a strictly positive crossing speed prove opposite local criticalities. The discriminant gives the sharp \(\alpha>5+2\sqrt6\) condition and both signs have rational parameter examples. A standalone verifier checks the nonstandard symbolic identities in unrestricted alpha and illustrates two cycles with high-precision arithmetic; simulations are not used to prove infinite statements. The planar neutral multiplier 1, the degenerate \(Q=0\) boundary and other cycles remain explicitly unproved.

originality.rationale: Direct material inspection of the 2026 motivating paper (model, coexistence formula, flip theorem and conclusions) finds its coexistence formula has a \(1-\alpha\beta\) denominator, while its flip reduction assumes the other eigenvalue has modulus not one; neither covers the aligned product-one equilibrium segment. The 2011 primary text discards \(\alpha\beta=1\) instead of treating coincident isoclines. The 2022 primary analysis discusses the product-one separatrix but does not give the invariant composition foliation, all-leaf two-cycle result, or exact Q criticality polynomial. The 2023 primary theorem covers both logarithmic growth parameters <=2, whereas the present result has \(R>2\). Published synchronized-cycle Floquet results concern row-regular matrix spectra, not this neutral foliation. The genuine contribution is the sharp leafwise period-doubling sign switch and global leafwise two-cycle existence, not generic scalar flip machinery; unindexed treatments remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed or difficult-to-search treatments of a rank-one Ricker competition foliation may contain equivalent flip normal-form calculations under other notation.
The 2022 PDF mirror has layout artifacts in mathematical formulas; relevant parameter boundary and dynamic-mode sections were still readable.
The 2023 manuscript was materially inspected in the main scope and introductory results; no claim of exhaustive review of every appendix is made.
A self-review is not independent verification or a proof of uniqueness among unpublished findings.

value.rationale: Exactly reciprocal competition is the natural singular boundary between weak and strong interspecific exclusion: isoclines become coincident under aligned intrinsic growth and the isolated equilibrium calculation breaks down. The exact conserved composition links that structural degeneracy to concrete ecological outcomes; it proves a genuine two-species cycle on every post-threshold composition leaf, while the analytic cubic coefficient and the sharp competition boundary \(\alpha>5+2\sqrt6\) distinguish both possible flip mechanisms. This is a motivated full-family classification with a nontrivial sign reversal and genuine cycles, not an arbitrary parameter increment or a reproduced standard scalar Ricker formula. Value does not assert global basin classification or field applicability.
